claims.claim: Guidewire cloud release cadence is three releases per year; recent releases are Olos (Dec 2025), Palisades (Apr 2026), Qusar (Aug 2026, current as of Nov 2026).
claims.quote: https://www.guidewire.com/products/technology/guidewire-cloud-platform-releases — release list shows “Qusar — Released: August 2026”, “Palisades — Released: April 2026”, “Olos — Released: December 2025”.
claims.falsifier: A newer public release page or a changed cadence.
claims.consequence: Pin release context per run; do not hard-code one release.

claims.claim: Only the current release and two most recent releases are supported (N−2).
claims.quote: Olos docs: “Only the current release and the two most recent releases are supported.” https://docs.guidewire.com/cloud/olos/whatsnew/topics/gwcp-release_highlights.html
claims.falsifier: A change to the support policy.
claims.consequence: Version warning rule is scoped to N−2.

claims.claim: APD conversion is a services-led Early Access offering, not a public self-service converter.
claims.quote: Guidewire blog, 12 Dec 2025: “combines advanced tooling with expert services”; current Cloud Retrofit docs label it “APD Conversion (EA)”. https://www.guidewire.com/resources/blog/developers/accelerate-your-cloud-transformation---convert-existing-policycenter-products-to-apd
claims.falsifier: A public self-service APD conversion product page.
claims.consequence: Do not claim to replace or reproduce APD conversion.

claims.claim: Vendor estimate: APD product conversion for most monoline products of average complexity takes 6–8 weeks, including testing; this is not a full migration estimate.
claims.quote: Blog: “Most monoline products of average complexity can be converted in just 6-8 weeks, including testing.”
claims.falsifier: Guidewire changes the estimate; independent data contradicts it.
claims.consequence: Cite as a vendor APD-conversion estimate, never as a full migration estimate or benchmark.

claims.claim: SBT lines could not be converted to APD-managed lines per the Olos release note.
claims.quote: Lines built from a Standards Based Template (SBT) cannot be converted to APD-managed lines at this time.
claims.falsifier: A later release note explicitly removing the limitation.
claims.consequence: SBT is a readiness flag, not a conversion attempt; re-verify on target release.

claims.claim: Cloud Retrofit is not APD conversion. The APD-assisted path imports a product into APD, generates endpoints, then deletes the product from APD.
claims.quote: “Cloud Retrofit with APD App”: after endpoint generation, “Delete the product from APD App”; the product cannot be maintained in APD. https://docs.guidewire.com/cloud/pc/202603/cloudapica/cloudAPI/topics/508-LOBEndpoints/01-generating-LOB-endpoints/cloud-retrofit-with-apd.html
claims.falsifier: A new documented process that keeps the product in APD.
claims.consequence: Target is a Cloud API extension draft, not APD conversion.

claims.claim: LOB extension file locations: `config/integration/schemas/ext/policyperiod/v1`, `config/integration/mappings/ext/policyperiod/v1`, `config/integration/updaters/ext/policyperiod/v1`, `config/integration/apis/ext/policyperiod/v1`; codegen/product access files in `config/integration/apis/installedlobs`; Gosu resources in `gsrc/gw/rest/ext/pc/policyperiod/<productCode>/v1`.
claims.quote: config/integration/schemas/ext/policyperiod/v1; config/integration/mappings/ext/policyperiod/v1; config/integration/updaters/ext/policyperiod/v1; config/integration/apis/installedlobs
claims.consequence: Exact draft paths; `_gen` files never edited; only `_ext` proposed.

claims.claim: `_gen` files are codegen output and must not be modified; `_ext` files are LOB extension files.
claims.quote: Same page: “Do not modify codegen output files directly. Any changes you make to these files will be overwritten…”; LOB extension files “have `<productCode>_ext` in their name.”
claims.consequence: Draft only `_ext`; `_gen` is read-only.

claims.claim: Personal Auto codegen config example: `PAVehicle: nameOverride: PersonalVehicle`; `PAVehicle.fields.Year: nameOverride: ModelYear`; `GarageLocation.requiredForCreate: false`; `autonumber: VehicleNumber`; `toCreateAndAdd: createAndAddVehicle`; `toRemove: removeVehicle`; `PADriver: nameOverride: VehicleDriver`; `PALine: nameOverride: PersonalAutoLine`.
claims.quote: PAVehicle: nameOverride: PersonalVehicle; Year: nameOverride: ModelYear; GarageLocation: requiredForCreate: false; autonumber: VehicleNumber; toCreateAndAdd: createAndAddVehicle; toRemove: removeVehicle; PADriver: nameOverride: VehicleDriver; PALine: nameOverride: PersonalAutoLine
claims.consequence: Use these as `guidewire-doc` mapping rules.

claims.claim: Field-level `nameOverride` is for Cloud Retrofit without APD App; for APD conversion or APD-assisted Retrofit use `schemaPropertyName`.
claims.quote: Codegen config syntax: “The nameOverride property should be used only for Cloud Retrofit without APD App. For Cloud Retrofit with APD App or APD conversion, use schemaPropertyName.”
claims.falsifier: A later doc removes the restriction.
claims.consequence: The product targets the non-APD Cloud Retrofit path; label this scope.

claims.claim: Endpoint-generation normalization: `VehicleDriver` → `Driver`, `PersonalVehicle` → `Vehicle`; `VehicleDriverExtResource.finishCreate` links the driver to `PALine`.
claims.quote: “Generating endpoints for the Personal Auto product,” published 22 Oct 2026: template changes and `finishCreate` code. https://docs.guidewire.com/cloud/pc/202603/cloudapica/cloudAPI/topics/508-LOBEndpoints/02-generating-endpoints-for-PA/c_generating-endpoints-for-the-Personal-Auto-product.html
claims.falsifier: A release changes the Personal Auto template.
claims.consequence: Separate API-naming rule from codegen overrides.

claims.claim: APD type names are limited to 24 characters; truncation causes compile errors fixed with `nameOverride` (example `WCRetroRatingLetterOfCredit` → `WCRetroRatingLetterOfCre`).
claims.quote: Paraphrase: APD limits type names to 24 characters; the documented correction is a codegen nameOverride with the full installed name.
claims.falsifier: A release changes the limit or auto-fix.
claims.consequence: Implement `PF-GW-NAM-001` on APD type names only; not all fields.

claims.claim: Cloud Assurance uses Studio inspections + Cloud Assurance Plugin + TeamCity Automated Cloud Assurance; build fails over a threshold and the PR is labelled `NEEDS WORK`; default timeout 120 minutes.
claims.quote: “Automated cloud assurance and code compliance”: exact process, `NEEDS WORK`, 120-minute timeout. https://docs.guidewire.com/cloud/gcc-guide/insurer-developer/latest/automated-cloud-assurance/
claims.consequence: Findings are advisory; UI shows “Official Cloud Assurance: not run.”

claims.claim: Exact Cloud Assurance threshold and full Cloud Standards corpus are not public.
claims.quote: The public page refers to “the threshold” without a number; standard pages redirect to `/gw-login`.
claims.consequence: Never invent a threshold or claim a pass/fail.

claims.claim: `IS-TLS-1238` = Use of Direct SQL Calls to Access a Database / JDBC; `IS-TLS-1191` = Hidden Package Reference; `IS-TLS-1022` = Deprecated API Usage; `IS-INT-1335` = Use of Guidewire Integration Framework.
claims.quote: Public hardening guidance lists the IDs/titles; full rule pages redirect to login.
claims.consequence: Use only verified IDs/titles; bodies labelled gated.

claims.claim: `SEC00-G` = Do Not Hardcode Secrets.
claims.quote: SEC00-G: Do Not Hardcode Secrets.
claims.falsifier: A change to the public guidance.
claims.consequence: `SEC00-G`/`ERR00-G` are Gosu secure-coding, not Cloud Standards; `standard_family` distinguishes them.

claims.claim: Custom servlets are not a recommended practice; integrations should use the approved REST API framework.
claims.quote: The use of custom servlets is not a recommended practice. All integrations should be implemented using the approved REST API framework.
claims.consequence: `PF-GW-SRV-001` is `verified-policy`, no `IS-*` ID.

claims.claim: Guidewire Studio manages PCF pages.
claims.quote: Use Studio to manage rule sets, Gosu classes, PCF pages, workflows, entity types, display keys, plugins, message destinations, and web services.
claims.falsifier: A public XSD or a doc that defines the acronym differently.
claims.consequence: PreFlight treats PCF files as XML page-configuration files and makes no canonical-XSD claim.

claims.claim: SonarQube Cloud added native Gosu analysis in September 2026.
claims.quote: Sonar blog, 4 Sept 2026: “SonarQube Cloud adds support for … Gosu”; “Gosu drives policy and claims logic.” https://www.sonarsource.com/blog/four-new-languages-arrive-in-sonarqube-cloud/
claims.consequence: Do not compete on generic Gosu linting; position on cross-artefact migration evidence.

claims.claim: Developer Assistants for Gosu, Integrations, and Jutro are GA in Qusar and use MCP; technical docs are gated.
claims.quote: Qusar release highlights and Guidewire blog, 10 Aug 2026. https://www.guidewire.com/resources/blog/developers/accelerating-p-c-delivery-with-developer-assistants-from-guidewire
claims.consequence: No integration; complementary review evidence.

claims.claim: TrainingApp, GO products, Marketplace content, and full Cloud Standards are gated/copyrighted; synthetic fixtures only.
claims.quote: Guidewire legal notices and Marketplace terms; public docs login notices. https://www.guidewire.com/legal-notices
claims.consequence: No redistribution; synthetic fixture.

claims.claim: The product’s impact range is a heuristic, not a price or measured productivity claim.
claims.quote: Heuristic planning range; not a quote.
claims.consequence: Label “heuristic planning range; not a quote.”

claims.claim: The fixture is synthetic and does not represent a real insurer estate.
claims.quote: PreFlight design decision.
claims.consequence: “Synthetic demo estate” badge from second zero.

claims.claim: The 5,000-file test is a throughput test, not a generalisation or estate-complexity claim.
claims.quote: PreFlight evaluation design.
claims.consequence: Label throughput in UI and report; thesis tier only.

claims.claim: Cloud Retrofit without APD App uses `<lob_prefix>_codegen_config_ext-1.0.yaml` and `template_gen_config.xml`; the APD App path additionally uses `template_gen_config.all.yaml` and `template_gen_config.<lob_prefix>.yaml`.
claims.quote: Cloud Retrofit without APD App: <lob_prefix>_codegen_config_ext-1.0.yaml; template_gen_config.xml
claims.falsifier: A release changes the file matrix.
claims.consequence: v5 chooses the without-APD-App path; `template_gen_config.xml` is read-only input; no YAML template config is drafted.

claims.claim: A Guidewire-hosted developer blog guest post describes explicit commits in `runWithNewBundle` as a Cloud Upgrade Estimate finding.
claims.quote: CUE reports flag explicit commits in runWithNewBundle.
claims.falsifier: A public standard explicitly covering it, or the blog changing.
claims.consequence: `PF-GW-TX-001` is `secondary`, not a Cloud Standard.

claims.claim: `PF-GW-LOG-001`, `PF-GW-LOG-002`, and `PF-GW-GUNIT-001` are PreFlight heuristics informed by general Guidewire hardening/unit-test guidance, not verified standards.
claims.quote: No exact public rule ID is claimed.
claims.falsifier: A verified public rule or quote that covers the exact check.
claims.consequence: These rules are `heuristic`, `standard_family: none`; UI labels them as heuristics.

claims.claim: Target draft paths: `config/integration/schemas/ext/policyperiod/v1`, `config/integration/mappings/ext/policyperiod/v1`, `config/integration/updaters/ext/policyperiod/v1`, `config/integration/apis/installedlobs`; product access file `<productCode>_ext-1.0.yaml`; `_gen` files are read-only.
claims.quote: _gen files are codegen output; _ext files are LOB extension files.
claims.consequence: `docs/target-format.md` and conformance tests use these exact paths.

claims.claim: The demo’s long-type example is a synthetic Personal Auto type name (`PersonalAutoRatingFactorConfiguration`, 37 chars), not a real Guidewire type.
claims.quote: PreFlight fixture design.
claims.consequence: Label the long type synthetic in the finding, reconstruction row, packet, and demo.

claims.claim: Source Sans 3 is licensed under the SIL Open Font License.
claims.quote: SIL Open Font License.
claims.consequence: If the font is bundled, include the OFL text; the current build uses a system font stack with Source Sans 3 first.

claims.claim: R-DOC-01 is evidence-only; R-UNR-01 and R-UNS-01 are reviewer decisions; R-TEST-01 is a PreFlight convention.
claims.quote: No target mapping for evidence-only artefacts; unresolved/unsupported require reviewer decisions.
claims.consequence: R-DOC-01/R-UNR-01/R-UNS-01/R-TEST-01 are documented in the mapping rule pack; unresolved/unsupported artefacts become gaps and assumptions rather than Mapping rows.

claims.claim: The long-type codegen draft uses the documented nameOverride mechanism.
claims.quote: nameOverride maps the truncated APD type name back to the installed type name.
claims.consequence: Codegen draft includes PersonalAutoRatingFactor -> PersonalAutoRatingFactorConfiguration.

claims.claim: `ERR00-G` = Do Not Suppress Exceptions.
claims.quote: ERR00-G: Do Not Suppress Exceptions.
claims.consequence: PF-GW-EXC-001 is a gosu-secure-coding rule.

claims.claim: `INJ00-G` states that JDBC is not supported on Guidewire Cloud.
claims.quote: JDBC is not supported on Guidewire Cloud.
claims.consequence: PF-GW-SQL-001 cites the SQL/JDBC family; IS-TLS-1238 remains the Cloud Standard title.

claims.claim: PreFlight treats PCF files as XML page-configuration files and does not claim a canonical public XSD.
claims.quote: Product interpretation; public docs reviewed on 7 Nov 2026 do not include a canonical XSD.
claims.falsifier: A public canonical XSD or a different PCF format definition.
claims.consequence: Parser uses lxml structure; no XSD-validation claim.

claims.claim: PF-GW-SBT-001 detection is a synthetic marker heuristic: it flags standardsBasedTemplate="true" and does not assert an official SBT assessment or conversion result.
claims.quote: The Olos release note documents the SBT conversion limitation; the marker detection itself is a PreFlight heuristic.
claims.falsifier: An official SBT assessment or a documented detection standard that replaces the marker heuristic.
claims.consequence: Rule and UI label PF-GW-SBT-001 as heuristic, standard_family=none, with no standard_id; the readiness flag remains separate from advisory findings.
